classification: Representable unchecked internal level-of-detail state and separate raw residency masks; an invalid value reaching the running product has not been established.
trace: The selected-to-current tree diff changes the asset-residency request from the per-tree mask and selected leaf to EVERY_TREE_TIER (six low bits) and None. Generation uses the trunk, detailed crown and four card tier bits; None causes both detailed leaf forms to be generated if absent. The changed capture-spec comment expresses an expected later no-generation property, not an observed runtime result.

A new StreamedTreePresentation initializes active_mask to u8::MAX and the two resident masks to zero. On a changed active state, the streamer uses a requested tree mask and a separate desired leaf mask to spawn only newly resident children, then updates those masks. Shared cached asset diagnostics accumulate generated_lod_mask by bitwise OR. These masks refer to distinct state and must not be treated as interchangeable merely because all are u8.

TreeLodRenderOverride.lod and CaptureViewSpec.render_lod_override are Option<u8>; the capture builder accepts any u8. In the streamer the Some(lod) branch computes 1 << (lod + 1) in a u8 mask. Values outside the supported tiers are representable internally and sufficiently large values exceed the mask shift width; static checked-in capture and performance selections cited here use 0 through 4. No reachable invalid input, build-profile behavior, crash, or rendering failure has been demonstrated.

The tree diff comment says requests occur during the loading screen, and the capture specification expresses an expected no-generation-on-approach result. Scheduling, all scene lifecycle gates and that performance claim remain unverified; no product validation was run.
repair_direction: Trace all override constructors and configuration paths, state transitions, native ECS and report boundaries. Determine a finite tree LOD owner or checked admission for supported tiers and distinguish tree-child, leaf-child and cached-asset masks where it protects real relationships. Preserve supported levels 0 through 4, the uninitialized active sentinel or an equivalent explicit state, None leaf handoff, cached assets and current child-spawn semantics. Resolve any loading-screen guarantee separately from this type question.
later_acceptance: After separate implementation authorization, verify all supported forced and natural LODs, both leaf forms and their handoff, empty and initialized resident state, shared cache reuse, and out-of-range override rejection.
Separately establish whether the loading gate and renderer satisfy the intended generation timing, without treating source comments as validation.
remaining: Inspect the rest of the tree and capture files, all override producers and selection/report consumers, scene lifecycle, arithmetic and historical aliases.
Do not assert equivalence of asset, child and leaf masks or product impact from the representable unchecked state. No repairs, build, test, graphics runtime or performance probe was performed.
